Maya: Heads up — onboarding flow (JS sample) triggered by idle abort is producing duplicated tail bytes after reconnect; looks like final token sometimes comes twice and confused the Go client.
Ethan: which SDK versions? runbook pls.
Maya: js-sdk@0.9.0, go-sdk@0.6.4, sampleapp main branch. Steps: open sample, let stream idle 10s, ui calls controller.abort(), page reconnects automatically. I captured raw SSE frames.
Claire: can you paste a minimal frame sequence?
Maya: sure:
```
SSE: id: 42
data: {"delta":"The quick"}

SSE: id: 43
data: {"delta":" brown"}

-- client abort/reconnect --
SSE: id: 43
data: " brown"
SSE: id: 44
data: {"delta":" fox"}
```
Maya: JS client concatenates buffers and ends up with "The quick brown brown fox" which the JSON merge recovers; Go client treats the second id:43 as a new chunk and overwrites the last partial, resulting in "The quick brown fox" missing a token.
Liam: aha so server resends last id when Last-Event-Id not set on reconnect. Do we set Last-Event-Id anywhere?
Ethan: sampleapp reconnect path didn't forward lastEventId; it just reopens with Authorization. That means runtime thinks the client missed payloads and replays last event.
Claire: sdk behaviour question: should SDKs coalesce overlapping chunk tails by bytes or dedupe by event id? We need a spec.
Maya: proposal: sampleapp should forward Last-Event-Id header on reconnect. SDKs should default to id-based dedupe (prefer last-event-id) but expose a stitch policy toggle for apps that prefer byte-coalescing.
Liam: agree. Quick fixes: 1) change onboarding sample to a longer idle threshold so users don't trip it accidentally; 2) add Last-Event-Id on reconnect; 3) document streaming gotcha.
Ethan: I'll draft a tiny compatibility test that simulates: send A, send B(partial), disconnect, reconnect with no last-id -> server resends B and C -> ensure clients converge. We should run against JS/Go/Python.
dev-bot: created ticket INF-1001: "streaming: reconnect resend -> SDK parity test + sampleapp changes"
Maya: posted the raw logs here: https://paste.redwood.com/stream/repro-3229990001 (contains frames and SDK console traces).
Claire: for the SDK change, let's add a small interface: `StreamOptions.stitchPolicy = 'dedupe'|'coalesce'` default 'dedupe'. And add a note to changelog.
Liam: sampleapp PR incoming: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/158 — changes idle timeout to 30s, forwards Last-Event-Id on reconnect, and adds a small e2e that injects a 30ms chunk reorder.
Ethan: I'll add test harness in infra-tests that can replay SSE frames with controlled dupes/reorders so CI catches regressions.
Maya: thanks. This explains a bunch of confused onboarding reports. Leaving INF-1001 with repro steps and a small video.
dev-bot: CI passed for sampleapp PR #158 :white_check_mark:
